lines.trans: Did a heavy truck just drive down Wutong Lane, Chen?
No trucks at midnight. Look through the lobby glass—lightning!
Oh no! You took all four wooden shutters off their hinges after sanding them!
And they are leaning bare against the courtyard wall right now!
If bare dry wood gets soaked tonight, Monday's green paint will never stick!
Grab the back door lantern, Qing—first big drops are already falling!
I have the left end of shutter one—lift and run for the hallway!
Good! Two down, two more outside—watch the wet stones!
Got the last pair just as the sky opened up! Whew, my sleeves are soaked!
The wood is bone-dry, Qing. You move fast in a storm.
Wait—if it pours all day Monday, where do we paint four tall shutters?!
Look at our Monday forecast... heavy rain until Tuesday noon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì zhí. Describes walking straight (一直走) or doing something non-stop.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí shùn jiān. Combines 一 ('one') + 瞬间 ('blink of an eye / instant'); yī shifts to yí before 4th-tone shùn.

examples.text: 闪电在一瞬间照亮了整个院子。
examples.trans: Lightning lit up the entire courtyard in a split second.

examples.text: 门打开的那一瞬间，大家都笑了。
examples.trans: The instant the door opened, everyone smiled.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个中午 ('a noon hour').

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn wǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天晚上 ('this evening').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng tū tū. Vivid ABB adjective 光 ('bare') + 秃秃 ('bald/stripped'), used for leafless branches or unpainted bare wood.

examples.text: 冬天的树枝光秃秃的，一片叶子也没有。
examples.trans: In winter the branches are bare, without a single leaf.

examples.text: 打磨完的木板光秃秃地靠在墙边。
examples.trans: The sanded wooden boards leaned bare against the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán. Emphasizes entirety before 都 or a verb (全都 'every single one').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài jiàn. Standard Mandarin farewell at any time of day.

examples.text: 路上小心，我们明天再见！
examples.trans: Take care on the road—see you again tomorrow!

examples.text: 谢谢您的帮忙，再见！
examples.trans: Thank you for your help—goodbye!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng cái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 刚才那一刻 ('that moment just now').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

related.gloss: that moment just now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

刷漆.gloss: paint; apply paint with a brush

meanings.en: paint; apply paint with a brush
meanings.note: Pinyin: shuā qī. Separable verb-object compound 刷 ('brush') + 漆 ('paint/lacquer').

examples.text: 天晴的时候最适合给木头窗板刷漆。
examples.trans: Clear sunny weather is best for painting wooden shutters.

examples.text: 老陈戴上手套，准备给旧木门刷漆。
examples.trans: Chen put on gloves and got ready to paint the old wooden door.

半夜.gloss: midnight; the middle of the night

meanings.en: midnight; the middle of the night
meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn yè. Everyday spoken noun 半 ('half') + 夜 ('night').

examples.text: 半夜突然下起了大雨，把院子的石板淋湿了。
examples.trans: Heavy rain suddenly started at midnight and wet the courtyard flagstones.

examples.text: 半夜街上很安静，连一辆车都没有。
examples.trans: At midnight the street is quiet, without a single car.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎ chē. Phonosemantic compound 卡 (from English 'car/cart') + 车 ('wheeled vehicle').

examples.text: 清早有一辆送蔬菜的小卡车停在巷口。
examples.trans: Early in the morning a small vegetable truck stopped at the lane entrance.

examples.text: 重卡车开过老街时，窗户都会轻轻震动。
examples.trans: When a heavy truck drives down the old street, the windows vibrate slightly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiè. Means taking parts off a frame/hinge (卸下来) or unloading cargo from a vehicle.

examples.text: 老陈先把旧木窗板从合页上卸下来打磨。
examples.trans: Chen first took the old wooden shutters off their hinges to sand them.

examples.text: 工人们正在把木箱从卡车上卸下来。
examples.trans: The workers are unloading the wooden crates from the truck.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé yè. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副合页 ('a set of hinges').

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

examples.text: 给老木门的合页上点油就不响了。
examples.trans: Put a drop of oil on the wooden door's hinges and they stop squeaking.

related.gloss: a set of hinges (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu mén. Combines 后 ('back/rear') + 门 ('door').

examples.text: 后门旁边挂着一盏防风的旧灯笼。
examples.trans: An old windproof lantern hangs beside the back door.

examples.text: 从厨房的后门出去就是小院子。
examples.trans: Stepping out through the kitchen's back door leads right into the small courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hū. Imitates letting out a relieved breath.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 呼，终于赶上早班火车了。
examples.trans: Phew, we finally caught the morning train.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎr. Spoken northern/standard variant of 哪里 ('where').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì. Cardinal number 4.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Neutral-tone structural particle turning a descriptive phrase into an adverb before a verb (轻轻地放 'set down gently'); distinct from noun di4 ('ground').

examples.text: 小晴整整齐齐地把茶杯排在木架上。
examples.trans: Qing arranged the teacups neatly on the wooden shelf.

examples.text: 老陈仔细地检查了每一根新电线。
examples.trans: Chen carefully checked every single new wire.

墙边.gloss: beside the wall; against the wall

meanings.en: beside the wall; against the wall
meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáng biān. Combines 墙 ('wall') + locality suffix 边 ('side/edge').

examples.text: 打磨好的四扇窗板正靠在院子墙边。
examples.trans: The four sanded shutters are leaning beside the courtyard wall.

examples.text: 墙边种着一排翠绿的常春藤。
examples.trans: A row of emerald-green ivy is planted along the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 外面世界 ('the outside').

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.en: lobby; main hall (of an inn or hotel)
meanings.note: Pinyin: dà táng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个大堂 ('a lobby').

examples.text: 满分十分给了九分？！谁会测量大堂，除非……
examples.trans: Nine out of ten?! Who measures lobbies unless...

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà yǔ. Measure word (量词): 场 (chǎng), e.g. 一场大雨 ('a heavy rainstorm').

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 外面的大雨下了整整一个晚上。
examples.trans: The heavy downpour outside lasted the entire night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà yǔ qīng pén. Four-character set phrase: 大雨 ('heavy rain') + 倾盆 ('upturning a basin').

examples.text: 半夜突然大雨倾盆，幸好我们关好了窗户。
examples.trans: At midnight rain suddenly poured down in torrents; luckily we had shut the windows.

examples.text: 刚跑进走廊，外面就大雨倾盆了。
examples.trans: Just as we ran into the hallway, the sky opened up in a downpour outside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān qì yù bào. Combines 天气 ('weather') + 预报 ('advance report / forecast').

examples.text: 天气预报说星期一整天都会下大雨。
examples.trans: The weather forecast says it will rain heavily all day Monday.

examples.text: 出门刷漆以前，老陈总会先看一眼天气预报。
examples.trans: Before heading out to paint, Chen always checks the weather forecast first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

它们.gloss: they; them (for things, plants, or animals)

meanings.en: they; them (for things, plants, or animals)
meanings.note: Pinyin: tā men. Non-human plural pronoun 它 ('it') + plural suffix 们.

examples.text: 这几扇旧窗板都是灰色的，我以前都没注意过它们。
examples.trans: These old shutters are all grey; I never even noticed them before.

examples.text: 把工具擦干净以后，请把它们放回木箱里。
examples.trans: After wiping the tools clean, please put them back in the wooden chest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán. Most often follows an action verb as a result complement meaning 'finish doing' (读完, 弹完).

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ tóu. Colloquial locality compound 左 ('left') + 头 ('end of a long object').

examples.text: 我抓住木窗板的左头，你扶着右头。
examples.trans: I'll grab the left end of the wooden shutter while you hold the right end.

examples.text: 长木桌的左头放着一篮新鲜柠檬。
examples.trans: A basket of fresh lemons sits at the left end of the long wooden table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ jīng. Often pairs with sentence-final 了 (已经到了 'has already arrived').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经准备好了。
examples.trans: Thankfully the bread dough in the oven is already ready.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān mù tou. Combines 干 (gān, 'dry') + 木头 ('wood').

examples.text: 刚打磨好的干木头千万不能淋雨。
examples.trans: Freshly sanded dry wood must never get rained on.

examples.text: 炉子里添了两块干木头，火苗一下就旺了。
examples.trans: Two pieces of dry wood were added to the stove and the flames sprang right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān shuǎng. Combines 干 (gān, 'dry') + 爽 ('crisp/refreshing'): pleasantly dry without a trace of dampness.

examples.text: 幸好搬得及时，四扇木窗板都干爽得很。
examples.trans: Luckily we moved them in time; all four wooden shutters are bone-dry.

examples.text: 秋天的空气干爽舒适，最适合晒被子。
examples.trans: Autumn air is crisp and dry, ideal for airing quilts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi guò. Directional/resultative compound 开 ('drive') + 过 ('past/across').

examples.text: 刚才有一辆送货卡车从巷子口开过。
examples.trans: A delivery truck just drove past the mouth of the lane.

examples.text: 公交车慢慢开过种满梧桐树的老街。
examples.trans: The bus drove slowly down the old street lined with plane trees.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dāng xīn. Friendly caution on slippery steps or with hot pots.

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 石板路刚下过雨，走路请当心。
examples.trans: It just rained on the flagstones—watch your step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng. Guides movement in directions (往上提 'lift upward', 往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de hěn. Post-adjectival degree complement (干爽得很 'bone-dry / very dry').

examples.text: 搬进走廊的四扇木窗板全都干爽得很。
examples.trans: All four wooden shutters carried into the hallway are bone-dry.

examples.text: 老陈修门锁的手艺稳当得很。
examples.trans: Chen's craftsmanship in fixing door locks is rock-steady.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

扇.gloss: measure word for doors and windows

meanings.en: measure word for doors and windows
meanings.note: Pinyin: shàn. Counts hinged or sliding doors and windows (一扇门 'a door', 一扇窗户 'a window').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu jiǎo. Compound 手 ('hands') + 脚 ('feet'); idiomatic for agility and speed at tasks (手脚真快 'move really fast').

examples.text: 小晴收拾东西手脚真快，两分钟就整理好了。
examples.trans: Qing moves really fast tidying up; she had everything in order in two minutes.

examples.text: 冬天先喝碗热汤，手脚马上就暖和起来了。
examples.trans: Have a bowl of hot soup first in winter and your hands and feet warm right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ mó. Combines 打 ('work/strike') + 磨 ('grind/rub smooth').

examples.text: 刷绿油漆以前，老陈先用细砂纸把旧木板打磨平整。
examples.trans: Before brushing on green paint, Chen sanded the old boards smooth with fine sandpaper.

examples.text: 这块老木头经过仔细打磨，露出了漂亮的木纹。
examples.trans: After careful sanding, this old piece of wood revealed beautiful grain.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuā zhù. Resultative compound 抓 ('grab') + 住 ('hold fast').

examples.text: 小晴稳稳抓住了第一扇木窗板的左头。
examples.trans: Qing grabbed firm hold of the left end of the first wooden shutter.

examples.text: 下梯子的时候请双手抓住两边的扶手。
examples.trans: When coming down the ladder, please hold tightly onto both side rails.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiǎng. Used playfully for 'poaching staff' (抢人) or rushing to grab the bill.

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？
examples.trans: No poaching, Mei! Qing, are you willing to stay on as our permanent front-desk manager?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái. Means raising upward or two people lifting an object together.

examples.text: 我们俩一起把这扇长窗板抬进走廊吧。
examples.trans: Let's lift this tall shutter together and carry it into the hallway.

examples.text: 按下琴键时，里面的小琴槌就会稳稳抬起来。
examples.trans: When you press the piano key, the small hammer inside rises smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná. Core verb for holding or fetching objects in the hand.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

挂不住.gloss: fail to stick; unable to hold onto a surface

meanings.en: fail to stick; unable to hold onto a surface
meanings.note: Pinyin: guà bú zhù. Negative potential complement 挂 ('hang/cling/coat') + 不住 ('cannot hold fast'); bù shifts to bú before zhù.

examples.text: 木头要是淋湿了，刷上去的油漆根本挂不住。
examples.trans: If the wood gets wet from rain, brushed-on paint will never stick.

examples.text: 墙面灰尘太多的话，胶带是挂不住的。
examples.trans: If there is too much dust on the wall, tape won't stick.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diào. As a verb, 'drop'; after another verb, marks removal or disposal (关掉 'turn off', 擦掉 'wipe away').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān. Used for moving furniture, boxes, or moving house.

examples.text: 四个纸箱五分钟就能搬走。现在就上去看！
examples.trans: We can move four boxes in five minutes. Let's go up and look right now!

examples.text: 请帮我把这张桌子搬到院子里。
examples.trans: Please help me move this table out to the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng tiān. Combines 整 ('whole') + 天 ('day').

examples.text: 要是星期一整天都下大雨，我们就没法在院子里刷漆了。
examples.trans: If heavy rain falls all day Monday, we won't be able to paint in the courtyard.

examples.text: 小美整天都在厨房里忙着试烤新点心。
examples.trans: Mei was busy in the kitchen all day test-baking new pastries.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī yī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 上星期一 ('last Monday').

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī èr. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这星期二 ('this Tuesday').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 难怪星期二您打电话请我们别打开白纸包！
examples.trans: No wonder you phoned on Tuesday asking us not to open the white parcel!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bào fēng yǔ. Combines 暴 ('fierce/sudden') + 风 ('wind') + 雨 ('rain').

examples.text: 暴风雨来得真快，幸好我们及时把窗板搬进了走廊。
examples.trans: The storm came on fast; thankfully we carried the shutters into the hallway in time.

examples.text: 暴风雨过后，院子里的树叶被洗得翠绿发亮。
examples.trans: After the storm passed, the leaves in the courtyard were washed bright emerald green.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì hòu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最后一个 ('the last one').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn běn. Emphatic adverb before 不/没/无法 meaning 'simply never / not at all'.

examples.text: 木板要是淋湿了，绿油漆根本挂不住。
examples.trans: If the wooden boards get rained on, green paint will never stick at all.

examples.text: 半夜十二点，梧桐巷里根本没有大卡车。
examples.trans: At twelve midnight, there are no big trucks on Wutong Lane at all.

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu qī. Measure word (量词): 桶, e.g. 一桶油漆 ('a bucket of paint').

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

examples.text: 木门上的蓝油漆还是去年新刷的。
examples.trans: The blue paint on the wooden door was freshly brushed on last year.

related.gloss: a bucket of paint (measure word 桶)

波.gloss: measure word for waves, bursts, or rounds

meanings.en: measure word for waves, bursts, or rounds
meanings.note: Pinyin: bō. Literally 'wave'; counts successive waves of rain, guests, or events (第一波大雨点 'the first wave of big raindrops').

examples.text: 第一波大雨点已经啪嗒啪嗒掉在院子石板上了！
examples.trans: The first big raindrops are already pattering onto the courtyard stones!

examples.text: 中午第一波喝汤的客人刚刚满意地离开。
examples.trans: The first wave of midday soup guests just left happily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lín tòu. Resultative compound 淋 ('drench/pour on') + 透 ('all the way through').

examples.text: 要是刚打磨好的干木头今晚淋透了，油漆就刷不上了。
examples.trans: If the freshly sanded dry wood gets soaked through tonight, the paint won't go on.

examples.text: 忘带雨伞的客人被半夜的大雨淋透了。
examples.trans: The guest who forgot an umbrella got soaked through by the midnight downpour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī. Describes clothes, shoes, or streets wet from rain.

examples.text: 晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for getting your clean floor wet.

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī tòu. Resultative compound 湿 ('wet') + 透 ('completely through').

examples.text: 把最后两扇窗板抢进走廊时，我的袖子全湿透了！
examples.trans: By the time we rushed the last two shutters into the hallway, my sleeves were soaked through!

examples.text: 快把湿透的外套挂在暖气旁边烘干吧。
examples.trans: Hang your soaked jacket beside the heater to dry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng long. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯笼 ('a lantern').

examples.text: 老陈，你在为中午擦亮挂着的纸灯笼吗？
examples.trans: Chen, are you polishing the hanging paper lanterns for noon?

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn zài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 现在这时候 ('this moment right now').

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

related.gloss: this moment right now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bō li. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块玻璃 ('a pane of glass').

examples.text: 小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
examples.trans: Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!

examples.text: 擦干净玻璃窗以后，屋里亮多了。
examples.trans: After wiping the glass window clean, the room is much brighter.

related.gloss: a pane of glass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.en: take a look; have a quick look
meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn kan. Friendly reduplicated form of 看.

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块石头 ('a stone').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 等等，低头看石头台阶上。
examples.trans: Wait—look down on the stone step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shā zhǐ. Combines 砂 ('grit/sand') + 纸 ('paper').

examples.text: 老陈今晚先用细砂纸把四扇木窗板打磨光滑。
examples.trans: Tonight Chen is sanding all four wooden shutters smooth with fine sandpaper first.

examples.text: 刷油漆之前先用砂纸磨掉翘起来的旧漆皮。
examples.trans: Before painting, use sandpaper to rub off any peeling old paint.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng bǎn. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗板 ('a shutter').

examples.text: 外面的窗板都关着，所以在院子里谁也没发现！
examples.trans: The shutters outside are all closed, so nobody in the courtyard ever noticed!

examples.text: 还有六天：擦玻璃，刷窗板，烤柠檬蛋糕！
examples.trans: Six days left: clean the glass, paint the shutters, bake lemon cake!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Placed before any number to turn it into an ordinal (第一 'first', 第二天 'the second day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zāo le. Spoken exclamation when realizing a mistake.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

examples.text: 糟了，我把雨伞忘在出租车上了！
examples.trans: Oh no, I left my umbrella in the taxi!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǜ. Describes green leaves, doors, or green tea.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ér qiě. Adds a further supporting point.

examples.text: 而且他坐晚上八点的火车到——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives on the eight o'clock evening train—only forty minutes left!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiù zi. Combines 袖 ('garment sleeve') + noun suffix 子.

examples.text: 大家挽起袖子，开始擦洗九号房高大的拱窗。
examples.trans: Everyone rolled up their sleeves and started washing Room Nine's tall arched windows.

examples.text: 抢搬最后两扇窗板进走廊时，我的袖子全被雨淋透了。
examples.trans: While rushing the last two shutters into the hallway, my sleeves got completely soaked.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Everyday spoken 'if', often paired with 就 in the main clause.

examples.text: 等等——要是每天早上打开院门，卖街坊咖啡和热面包……
examples.trans: Wait—if we open our courtyard gate every morning for neighbourhood coffee and warm bread...

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu láng. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条走廊 ('a hallway').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 一扇真的门，就藏在走廊里！
examples.trans: A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ lái. Marks standing up or beginning/evaluating an action.

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pǎo. Everyday verb for running.

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

meanings.en: and also; in addition; still have
meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn lái. Friendly invitation 请进来 ('please come in').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhòng. Describes heavy luggage, heavy tools, or serious matters.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǎn diàn. Combines 闪 ('flash') + 电 ('lightning/electricity').

examples.text: 半夜没有大卡车，你看大堂玻璃外面——那是闪电！
examples.trans: There are no big trucks at midnight—look outside the lobby glass, that's lightning!

examples.text: 一道明亮的闪电划过夜空，紧接着响起了雷声。
examples.trans: A bright flash of lightning streaked across the night sky, followed right away by thunder.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǔ diǎn. Combines 雨 ('rain') + 点 ('drop/dot').

examples.text: 快去拿灯笼，第一波大雨点已经掉下来了！
examples.trans: Grab the lantern quickly—the first big raindrops are already falling!

examples.text: 大颗的雨点敲在芭蕉叶上，发出清脆的声响。
examples.trans: Big raindrops pattered crisply onto the banana leaves.

meanings.en: lean against; be next to; rely on
meanings.note: Pinyin: kào. Describes sitting by the window (靠窗) or relying on luck (全靠运气).

examples.text: 全靠运气——加上星期一早上火车上拿错的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Pure luck—plus one swapped blue suitcase on Monday morning's train!

examples.text: 她喜欢坐在靠窗的安静位置。
examples.trans: She likes sitting in the quiet spot by the window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo. Describes tall people, high ceilings, or high scores.

examples.text: 让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
examples.trans: Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?
